reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Yes, you can squat without sleeves. They add warmth and a bit of confidence under heavy load, but they don't make the lift possible. If you're training without them, keep your loads honest, warm up thoroughly, and drop the weight a notch when you're still building up to heavy sets. If you want to see how the new setup feels, start with a lighter day and work back up."}
